definitions.label: Spectral focus
definitions.description: Reads Spectral focus in Hz. The standing-wave pattern follows this control.

definitions.label: Displacement
definitions.description: Reads pitch displacement in semitones. Moves the standing-wave pattern with the effect.

definitions.label: Afterimage
definitions.description: Reads the Afterimage amount. Controls the field's purple memory glow.

definitions.label: Energy response
definitions.description: Smooths audio energy and dominant frequency, and measures the upper frequency bands. Drives motion and light.

definitions.label: Standing-wave modes
definitions.description: Turns focus, pitch displacement and measured sound into two smoothly changing standing-wave modes.

definitions.label: Nacre scene
definitions.description: Hosts the renderer, cabinet frame, sockets and controls. Shares placement, touch and animation phase with its objects.

definitions.label: Standing-wave field
definitions.description: Draws the standing-wave surface, contours and particles. Responds to sound, the effect controls and touch.

definitions.label: Prism edge
definitions.description: Reads Prism edge in Hz. Tilts the Oracle creature with the effect control.

definitions.label: Prism heat
definitions.description: Reads Prism heat in dB. Chooses the creature pose and lights its mouth.

definitions.label: Creature motion
definitions.description: Chooses a pose, tilt and mouth light from sound, Prism controls, hover and dragging.

definitions.label: Oracle poses
definitions.description: Provides an ordered set of project images. Connect it to Select image frame to choose the visible pose.

definitions.label: Select image frame
definitions.description: Chooses one image from a sequence. Frame 0 is the first image; a connected value overrides the Frame control.

definitions.label: Transform image
definitions.description: Moves, rotates, scales and fades an image. Connected values override the matching controls. Position is measured in image widths.

definitions.label: Creature in scene
definitions.description: Places the selected creature image on Nacre’s rim and gives its mouth a light and drag target.

definitions.label: Oracle creature
definitions.description: The shell creature on Nacre’s rim. Enter its graph to see the pose images, touch and sound rules, tilt and mouth light.

definitions.label: Cabinet engraving
definitions.description: Provides an ordered set of project images. Connect it to Select image frame to choose the visible pose.

definitions.label: Engraving in cabinet
definitions.description: Fits the connected engraving image inside the cabinet frame, preserving its centre crop and transparency.

definitions.label: Cabinet engraving
definitions.description: The engraved background plate. Enter to inspect its uploaded image, placement and how it fits within the cabinet frame.

definitions.label: Photographed relic
definitions.description: Provides an ordered set of project images. Connect it to Select image frame to choose the visible pose.

definitions.label: Relic height map
definitions.description: Provides an ordered set of project images. Connect it to Select image frame to choose the visible pose.

definitions.label: Relic relief
definitions.description: Draws the photographed relic with its height map. Shares its actual surface and relief shader with the eye.

definitions.label: Mouth relic
definitions.description: The photographed relic around the input socket. Its height map and sound drive the relief; its surface carries the eye. Enter to inspect the images and placement.

definitions.label: Memory hold
definitions.description: Reads Hold. The eyelid closes while spectral memory is held.

definitions.label: Gaze and blink
definitions.description: Follows the pointer, glances with sound and blinks. Produces separate opacities for the left gaze, right gaze and closed eyelid.

definitions.label: Eye images
definitions.description: Provides an ordered set of project images. Connect it to Select image frame to choose the visible pose.

definitions.label: Eye on relic
definitions.description: Draws the three connected eye images on the relic, shares its relief, lights the eye and makes it clickable for Hold.

definitions.label: Relic eye
definitions.description: The relic eye follows the pointer, glances with the sound, blinks and closes for Hold. Enter to inspect its three images, fades and motion script.

definitions.label: Scatter
definitions.description: Reads Scatter. Turns the hand and its engraved bearing.

definitions.label: Grain
definitions.description: Reads Grain in milliseconds. Tilts the wrist and turns the inner bearing.

definitions.label: Transmutation
definitions.description: Reads Transmutation. Turns the memory halo around the crystal.

definitions.label: Wrist and bearings
definitions.description: Turns and presses the wrist and bearings using Grain, Scatter and touch. Local drag values lead audio acknowledgements.

definitions.label: Memory collar motion
definitions.description: Turns and expands the halo using Transmutation and Afterimage. Selects the hand’s closed, middle or open grasp.

definitions.label: Hand poses
definitions.description: Provides an ordered set of project images. Connect it to Select image frame to choose the visible pose.

definitions.label: Wrist graft
definitions.description: Provides an ordered set of project images. Connect it to Select image frame to choose the visible pose.

definitions.label: Hand in scene
definitions.description: Draws the connected hand and wrist images, adds crystal relief and bearings, and makes the visible silhouette draggable.

definitions.label: Memory halo
definitions.description: Attaches the engraved memory collar to the connected hand. Drag to change Transmutation and Afterimage.

definitions.label: Crystal hand
definitions.description: Grain and Scatter move the hand; Transmutation and Afterimage move its halo. Enter to inspect the poses, wrist graft, motion scripts and real scene attachment.
